references.text: Balak had summoned Balaam to curse Israel, which shows his original intention.
Balak promised to honor Balaam richly if he came to curse Israel.
Balaam's first speech where he explains that he cannot curse those whom God has not cursed.
Balak expresses similar frustration after Balaam blesses Israel three times.
Moses reminds Israel how the Lord turned Balaam's curse into a blessing.
Joshua reminds the people that God would not listen to Balaam, but turned the curse into a blessing.
Nehemiah refers to how God turned Balaam's curse into a blessing.
Micah reminds Israel of Balak's plans and Balaam's response to show God's righteous deeds.
